versions.changelog: Add UTM attribution tags (utm_source=clawhub) to ClawLink branding links so visits from this skill page are tracked as a distinct traffic source.

- No other changes to skill features or documentation.

- Added a Microsoft Excel logo image at the top of the main documentation for clearer branding.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.
- No feature or API changes; documentation only.
Fixed footer logo: using link_logo_black_small.png (200px) instead of large clawlink-512.png.
Restored Excel-specific GIF for Step 3. Excel skill has its own app connection GIF.
Removed app-specific GIF from Step 3. Step 3 is now text-only placeholder as app-specific GIFs will be added by the user manually per skill.
Added ClawLink logo footer. Finalized 3-step GIF template with shared install/pair GIFs and app-specific connect GIF.
Updated Step 1 GIF to initialstep_1.gif (740x480) for better resolution and equal display with other steps.
Reverted Step 1 GIF back to install-step.gif which has better resolution for equal display.

Updated Step 1 GIF to use installexcelgif.gif for better Excel-specific install visualization.
Added 3-step visual setup guide with GIFs: Install, Pair Account, and Connect Excel. Placed before How It Works section for better onboarding.
Test: Added GitHub-hosted install-step.gif to verify ClawHub image rendering from approved domains.

Added visual enhancements: external image, ASCII architecture diagrams, workbook path diagram, cell range visual, table structure example, and execution workflow diagram. Testing ClawHub rendering capabilities.

Complete rewrite: added comprehensive tool reference tables, quick start examples, authentication guide, workbook access patterns, error handling table, and improved keywords. Removed powered by ClawLink from description.

- Initial release of the Microsoft Excel skill powered by ClawLink.
- Allows users to manage workbooks, worksheets, tables, ranges, and spreadsheet data from chat.
- Utilizes ClawLink for easy connection and credential management—no manual Microsoft Excel API setup needed.
- Features dynamic discovery and execution of Excel tools based on connected account and permissions.
- Includes setup instructions and clear guidelines for secure and correct use of the skill.
